pages.text: Mariculture provides a couple ways to breathe/work underwater better. From the simplicity of the snorkel to advanced scuba gear tech.
pages.title: Introduction

pages.text: $(l)Snorkel$()$(br)The snorkel is the simplest gear. Worn on your head under water, it tops up your air a little every other moment, so you can stay down far longer. It cannot take enchanted books.
$(l)Lifejacket$()$(br)Worn in the chest slot, the buoyancy aid carries you quickly up to the surface and keeps you floating there without holding jump. Sneak to stay low in the water.
